title: Mona Kattan's Kayali commits $250,000 to Make-A-Wish International
summary: The commitment has been made through the Mona Kattan-founded fragrance brand’s philanthropic arm, Kayali Cares, which was launched in 2025

extraction.key_fact: 모나 카탄의 향수 브랜드 Kayali가 사회공헌 조직 Kayali Cares를 통해 Make-A-Wish International에 기부를 약정했다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: The commitment has been made through the Mona Kattan-founded fragrance brand’s philanthropic arm, Kayali Cares, which was launched in 2025
